radius.default: 0 (square) on the public site; rounded only for avatars

motion.hero: word-by-word wipe-in, parallax drift on scroll, animated counters
motion.reel: pinned horizontal scroll (DriverReel) on >=1024px, snap-scroll row otherwise
motion.ambient: pointer spotlight (fine pointers only), scanline sweep, grain

patterns: leaning (skewX -8deg) display headlines with one outlined word

must: Site palette (page/surface/accent, racing-yellow/carbon-*) never mixes with the admin palette (background/card/muted/primary)
Public site reads drivers/sponsors/about/car from src/data/site-data.json; articles and calendar from the database
avoid: Rounded cards with borders as the default container

decisions.title: Pit-wall editorial redesign
decisions.summary: Full-bleed photography, oversized Rajdhani headlines, square hairline layouts, racing-yellow as the only colour. Grounded in 21st.dev: Logo Marquee (ddoemonn, #23537) and Team Showcase (makviesainte, #10098) adapted into project tokens as LogoMarquee and DriverShowcase.

decisions.title: Broadcast / onboard-feed redesign (supersedes pit-wall editorial)
decisions.summary: Full-strength hero video under scanlines and grain, HUD corner readouts in JetBrains Mono, glass pill navigation with lap-timer progress bar, pinned horizontal driver reel, tilting news cards, split-flap countdown, pointer spotlight. Yellow on carbon remains the only palette.
